description: This file contains Lua test scripts for error handling, syntax validation, and edge case testing, including assertions, error message checks, and stack overflow simulations.

methods.name: checkerr
methods.description: Checks that a function call results in an error message containing a specific substring.

methods.name: doit
methods.description: Loads and executes a string as Lua code, returning error messages if any.

methods.name: checkmessage
methods.description: Verifies that executing a Lua program produces an error message containing a specific substring.

methods.name: checksyntax
methods.description: Checks that a given Lua code snippet produces a syntax error with expected message components.

methods.name: lineerror
methods.description: Checks that loading a Lua code snippet results in an error at the expected line number.

methods.name: checksize
methods.description: Verifies the size of the source info string generated by load, ensuring it does not exceed LUA_IDSIZE.
